# DepthPicture

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Editing` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public static class DepthPicture
```

Turns an ordinary picture into a [`DepthMap`](../nfty-ticket/Nfty.Core.Model.DepthMap.md): the way an author who draws depth in any pixel editor hands it to nfty. The red channel is the front depth, the green channel the back depth; blue and alpha are ignored, so a picture that happens to carry them (a preview, a screenshot of the map) reads the same as one that does not.

```csharp
public static DepthMap ToMap(Image<Rgba32> picture);
```

Reads front (red) and back (green) depth, pixel for pixel, from a picture.

**Parameters**

- `picture` (`Image<Rgba32>`) - The depth picture; its size becomes the map's size.

**Returns.** A new [`DepthMap`](../nfty-ticket/Nfty.Core.Model.DepthMap.md) the size of the picture.
